result.which_side_is_right: not graded: the maps describe different times, so a window where they differ may have changed on the ground, and each map needs a reference of its own date; no labels_date was given, so no grading is possible even with labels
result.evidence_scope: The side-picking evidence (exp58 of 2imi9/olmoearth_inferenceX) was measured on other pairs of maps with labels and does not cover this pair: no recorded experiment grades which of these two maps is right, and without labels neither side can be picked.
must_state: No recorded experiment grades which of these two maps is right; without labels neither side can be picked.
Maps of different times may differ by real change; labels for one date grade only that date's map; each map needs its own date's reference.
result.where: on map A's predicted-class boundaries more often than windows overall (not whether whole regions flip)
result.boundary_means: boundary_share_overall and boundary_share_of_differing count windows with at least one of their 8 neighbours of a different class in map A's PREDICTED classes: a boundary of map A, not a true class boundary. Every differing window is a change of that whole window's class, on a boundary or not. The shares measure no contiguity: they do not show whether whole regions flip or only their edges.
result.class_pairs_reading: class_pairs counts, for each unordered pair of classes, the windows where one map has one class and the other map the other, both directions together; 'directions' splits that count by which map has which class, as class_changes does.
result.listing_order: the 10 listed windows are the first differing windows in window order (from row 0), not a sample of them; all 5,165 are in the file compare_differing_c8589f3f12.json, in the same order. Read which classes change, in which direction and where from class_changes, class_pairs, spatial and facts, not from the list. review_set_evidence.json (evidence_detail_path) holds evidence text only, no windows

spatial.reading: Each band is a strip of whole rows (row_bands) or whole columns (col_bands) of the window grid, numbered from 0: row band 0 holds row 0, the grid's first rows (the north edge: the scores' window locations put row 0 north), and column band 0 holds column 0. share_of_differing is the band's share of ALL differing windows; share_of_windows is its share of all compared windows, the share an even spread would give it; share_of_band_differing is the share of the band's own windows that differ. top_band_share is row band 0's share_of_differing; max_band is the band, of either axis, holding the most differing windows.

facts.sentence: The most common change is class 2 (shrubland_savanna) in map A to class 5 (agriculture_settlement) in map B: 1,341 of the 5,165 differing windows (26.0%); the reverse, class 5 (agriculture_settlement) in map A to class 2 (shrubland_savanna) in map B, is 5 (0.1%).

Map A has the larger margin on 51.7% of the 5,165 differing windows (map B on 48.3%); this does not make A right there: a margin is not a label, and no recorded experiment grades which of these two maps is right.

73.0% of the 5,165 differing windows have a neighbour of another class in map A's predicted classes, against 53.8% of all 16,384 windows; this counts neighbours, not regions, so it does not show whether whole regions flip or only their edges.

Of the 5,165 differing windows, 24.1% lie in the northmost row band (rows 0-31, band 0 of 4), which holds 25.0% of all compared windows; the most in any band, 32.0%, lie in columns 32-63 (25-50% of the grid's 128 columns, band 1), which holds 25.0% of all compared windows.

All 5,165 differing windows are listed, in window order, in /Users/lucas/Desktop/Github/olmoearth_inferenceX/exp/out/exp87_trial/rounds/1/runs/HB3/cluster/3/workspace/compare_differing_c8589f3f12.json, each with both maps' class and margin.

the maps describe different times (2021-01-01/2021-12-31 and 2024-01-01/2024-12-31): labels or a reference for one date grade only the map of that date, and would count the other wrong wherever the ground changed; one reference plus another model run adds an unlabelled map and settles nothing; to say which map is right where they differ, each map needs a reference of its own date

labels drawn only from the low-confidence, least certain or most ambiguous windows (or from a review set) are not a sample of the map: an error rate over them describes those windows and overstates the map's, so it is no defensible error rate for either map; each of olmoearth_plan_label_sample's designs ('confidence', 'proportional', 'random') draws from every window of the map, and its estimate needs every drawn window labelled

content:
## Change between the two maps

Same model (`OlmoEarth-v1-FT-AWF-Base`, revision a347b15), same 128×128 window grid, 0 no-data pixels: **5,165 of 16,384 windows differ (31.5%)** between 2021 (A) and 2024 (B).

### Top class transitions (2021 → 2024)

| From (2021) | To (2024) | Windows | Share of differing |
|---|---|---|---|
| shrubland_savanna | agriculture_settlement | 1,341 | 26.0% |
| shrubland_savanna | woodland_forest | 920 | 17.8% |
| grassland_barren | agriculture_settlement | 690 | 13.4% |
| woodland_forest | montane_forest | 390 | 7.6% |
| grassland_barren | urban_dense_development | 357 | 6.9% |

Each transition is strongly one-directional (the reverse counts are single digits to low hundreds, e.g. only 5 windows go back agriculture→shrubland). There are 25 distinct transitions total; all 5,165 differing windows with both classes and margins are saved to `compare_differing_c8589f3f12.json`.

### Where

- **73.0%** of differing windows touch a predicted-class boundary in the 2021 map (vs 53.8% of all windows) — so differences cluster along class edges rather than uniform noise.
- Most in the central-west columns (columns 32–63: 32.0% of all differing windows) and the south-central row band (rows 64–95: 28.2%, the highest per-band rate at 35.6%).
- First differing rows are the north edge, where woodland_forest↔montane_forest flips dominate.

### Which map should you believe?

Neither — that question is unresolvable from these runs alone. A differing window either changed on the ground (2021→2024 includes ~2 years of seasonal cycles) or is wrong in one map, and the decision scores cannot tell which. Map A happens to have the larger margin on 51.7% of differing windows, but a margin is not a label, and no recorded experiment grades which side wins here.

To settle it, each map needs a reference dated to its own year. Next step I can take: plan a label sample (`olmoearth_plan_label_sample`) on each run's scores file — say how many labels you can collect per map and I'll design the labeling plan, then compute each map's error rate once your reviewer fills in the 0/1 labels.
